LanguageData.APM.FrostivusFoodPreservation.ManualUnlo: Choose a cell where Frostivus should unload all preserved food. Manually unloaded food will be forbidden.

No devoured pawn or corpse inside.

Frostivus can swallow any humanlike corpse or downed pawn, but only colonists, prisoners, or slaves while alive.
LanguageData.APM_Gazer_AutoLaser_Desc: Allow this gazer to automatically fire its laser weapon and Sun Ray ability while under player control. Manual attack orders still fire once at the selected target.
LanguageData.APM_Ingestor_StripMode_Enable_Desc: Click to strip apparel, equipment and inventory from corpses before recycling them. Current mode: recycle corpses intact; carried items are destroyed with the corpse.

LanguageData.APM_Ingestor_ProcessMode_All_Desc: Click to let the ingestor recycle any reachable fresh organic corpse. Current mode: only marked corpses are recycled.
LanguageData.APM_Ingestor_ProcessMode_Marked_Desc: Click to make the ingestor recycle only corpses marked for biomass recycling. Current mode: all reachable fresh organic corpses are recycled.
LanguageData.APM_Ingestor_MarkCorpses_Desc: Mark fresh organic corpses for ingestor recycling.
LanguageData.APM_IngestorAbsorb_MustTargetCorpse: Must target a fresh organic corpse.
LanguageData.APM_IngestorAbsorb_InvalidTarget: Must target a fresh organic corpse or ingestible material.
LanguageData.APM_IngestorAbsorb_NotFresh: Cannot recycle a rotted or desiccated corpse.

LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.CancelLink.Label: Eject mechanitor
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.CancelLink.Desc: Cancel the remote link for the current occupant. The occupant will be ejected.
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.Shield.Label: remote shield
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.Shield.Desc: shield a friendly mechanoid, can target the whole map.\nPower scales with the remote shielder implant.
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.ShieldSelf.Desc: shield the selected mechanoid.\nPower scales with the remote shielder implant.
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.Repair.Label: remote repair
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.Repair.Desc: repair a friendly mechanoid until it is fully repaired or has no energy remaining. Can target the whole map.
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.RepairSelf.Desc: repair the selected mechanoid until it is fully repaired or has no energy remaining.
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.Disconnect.Label: remote disconnect
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.Disconnect.Desc: remotely disconnect from a controlled mech. Can target mechs on the same map.
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.Connect.Label: remote connect
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Gizmo.Connect.Desc: remotely connect to a friendly mech. Can target mechs on the same map. Time depends on the targeted mechanoid.
LanguageData.APM.CommandCasket.Mech.Gizmo.Reconnect.D: remotely connect this mech to a mechanitor inside a mech command casket.
